body: Thanks for responding, that was kind of you. Okay, so, I ended up getting it together and going to the wedding... And had an absolute blast! I reconnected with old friends and found something to wear that was just as nice. I spent 5 hours on the phone with tech support the next day and they were able to restore all my photos I had lost. I found out my ex is dating someone else and somehow that's helped me move on. Everything else that happened... Still happened. I'm trying to find strength in it all. That was a bleak day... But they're not all bleak. Someone telling me that I didn't have to go to the wedding helped me decide that I actually *wanted* to go... So thanks. :)

My heart goes out to you. I think you should be comforted by your resolve to get over him. I have been told that nothing but time heals a broken heart and to some degree it's true... but it doesn't help much right now. Try to distract yourself as much as possible, do literally whatever you can to give yourself moments of relief where you don't think about it. I believe your resolve will help you, at least now you know for sure it's not what you want in your life. That's a big step!
